206:t_1:3.en: ～$$メリダ島$$　$$ミスリル$$ $$西太平洋戦隊$$ Headquarters　Office～

206:t_1:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「...$c has evaded $$サイデリアル$$'s pursuit and successfully escaped Eurasia.」

206:t_1:6.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What shall we do, Captain?」

206:t_1:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Normally, we should leave here and go support them, but...」

206:t_1:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You're concerned about 《$$アマルガム$$》...」

206:t_1:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$'s investigation revealed that their collaborators are hiding within $$ミスリル$$ as well...」

206:t_1:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, we still haven't grasped the full extent of their organization.」

206:t_1:11.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Even when we find a promising source, the channel is cut off at once, and we can investigate no further...」

206:t_1:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I suspect they make decisions through a council of powerful executives rather than a pyramid with orders from the top.」

206:t_1:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「And those executives are spread worldwide. Whether someone leaves or someone new joins, the network continues unbroken...」

206:t_1:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's like a spider's web. With that structure, they have no leader, so we can't deliver a decisive blow...」

206:t_1:15.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$アマルガム$$ continues operating even as the Empire tries to rule the world.」

206:t_1:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They helped $$ジェミニス$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$ too. They are probably still in league with the Empire.」

206:t_1:17.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Do they intend to sell Earth to those people...?」

206:t_1:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The emergency line...?! What could be...!」

206:t_1:22.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes. I'm $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

206:t_1:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I'm an executive of $$アマルガム$$, your enemy at $$ミスリル$$.」

206:t_1:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you shocked that I know the $$西太平洋戦隊$$'s emergency communications code?」

206:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No... I'm just a little surprised you showed your face to me directly.」

206:t_1:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even through a monitor, this is our first reunion in six years. We're siblings, twins even. Couldn't you look a little happier?」

206:t_1:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Shall we talk a little about Dad and Mom?」

206:t_1:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm surprised. I didn't think you still remembered Dad and Mom.」

206:t_1:31.en:
$$レナード$$
「I remember. That's the problem.」

206:t_1:32.en:
$$レナード$$
「You've grown, $$テレサ$$. You're much stronger and more beautiful than before.」

206:t_1:33.en:
$$レナード$$
「Perhaps piloting that prized spacefaring submarine of yours has been a good experience.」

206:t_1:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I've lost many of my people fighting you.」

206:t_1:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If I had learned nothing from that, I would be insulting their lives.」

206:t_1:38.en:
$$レナード$$
「The dead have neither honor nor dignity.」

206:t_1:39.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Did you go to the trouble of contacting us to have this conversation?」

206:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let me be clear. You're my enemy, Brother.」

206:t_1:41.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I wanted to settle this just by talking...」

206:t_1:43.en:
$$レナード$$
「I see you've made up your mind.」

206:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is your last warning. Stop helping them.」

206:t_1:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$... You're the one who should finally give up on them.」

206:t_1:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll take that as your final decision.」

206:t_1:48.en:
$$レナード$$
「Goodbye, $$テレサ$$... You and everything you hold dear will soon come to an end.」

206:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$マデューカス$$, issue an emergency alert across $$メリダ島$$ immediately and send all personnel to battle stations.」

206:t_1:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$アマルガム$$'s all-out assault is finally beginning...)

206:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$, $$カナメ$$... I pray you're both safe.)

206:t_1:59.en:
$$田中司令$$
「All right, everyone... Thank you for your hard work. Now we're safe at the Far East Branch, the Empire's pursuers won't strike easily.」

206:t_1:60.en:
$$赤木$$
「Thank you too, $$田中$$. Securing a retreat route from $$ラース・バビロン$$ to Japan must have been hard.」

206:t_1:61.en:
$$田中司令$$
「It was, somewhat... But we had to prevent $c's destruction at any cost.」

206:t_1:62.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Was $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ in Eurasia the whole time?」

206:t_1:63.en:
$$葵$$
「Pretty much. We wanted to join $c, but $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ wouldn't allow it.」

206:t_1:64.en:
$$くらら$$
「We were to destroy enemy bases between $$ラース・バビロン$$ and Japan in case things went wrong. That was our mission.」

206:t_1:66.en:
$$葵$$
「Even hearing that, I can't exactly feel happy in this situation.」

206:t_1:67.en:
$$朔哉$$
「We met everyone from $$２１世紀警備保障$$ during those battles.」

206:t_1:69.en:
$$横沢$$
「We were rescuing refugees in Eurasia on the President's orders, but we'd nearly run out of options.」

206:t_1:70.en:
$$大山$$
「With $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s help, we managed to get those people out, and...」

206:t_1:71.en:
$$谷川$$
「You picked us up too. That's two birds with one stone.」

206:t_1:72.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「We're honored to have been of service.」

206:t_1:73.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So you joined up with Colonel $$シャア$$ once you'd secured the route.」

206:t_1:74.en:
$$マオ$$
「If the Colonel hadn't deployed his forces, we'd never have made it to Japan.」

206:t_1:75.en:
$$田中司令$$
「His forces have since joined the local resistance. Colonel $$シャア$$ and $$マリーダ$$ will stay with $c for the time being.」

206:t_1:76.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「The question is what we do now...」

206:t_1:77.en:
$$中原$$
「The captains have been meeting with Director $$大塚$$ all this time, but...」

206:t_1:78.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「It's understandable. Now our all-or-nothing assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$ has failed, the war against the Empire will likely become a quagmire.」

206:t_1:79.en:
$$くらら$$
「Japan was fairly peaceful, thanks to its position between southeast Eurasia's last defensive line and $$新日本$$'s efforts, but...」

206:t_1:81.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So even Japan, the last peaceful place on $$蒼の地球$$, will be engulfed in war...」

206:t_1:82.en:
$$入江$$
「If that happens, our company too...」

206:t_1:83.en:
$$石塚$$
「Don't say such unlucky things, $$入江$$.」

206:t_1:84.en:
$$田口$$
「That's right...! If I think about the company going under...」

206:t_1:85.en:
$$伊集院$$
「There's no hope! Our future looks bleak...」
